calls.video_title: Forget the NVIDIA Dip (3 Stocks That Are Actually Cheap)
calls.price_at_call: Breakout above $45 (2021 high, just below it); bull ~$60 within 12 months
calls.thesis: Recession-resistant consumer staples/pet company, ~$2.6bn market cap, trading at 14x forward earnings (below 16x sector median) with earnings expected +27% over 4 years, ~$300m/year free cash flow and a healthy balance sheet. Stock has traded sideways ~5-6 years; a break above the $45 2021 high is the trigger.
calls.base_case: Cheap valuation with steady pet/garden demand; range-bound until the breakout.
calls.bull_case: Breaks above $45 and runs to ~$60 within 12 months as price moves ahead of fundamentals.
calls.bear_case: Five-plus years sideways for a reason; in a recession pet owners may trade down on food/spend, and the breakout may not come.
